script: What if editing a photo was just... turning a dial?
Each edit is an arrow: the model's guess with the word, minus without it.
Make every arrow the same length, and mixing edits is just an angle.
Spin it halfway round, and old runs backwards: younger!
Attention masks keep the glasses on the eyes, not the whole face.
It works on cars, dogs, cats, even paintings.
No retraining. Just spin the dial.
